JUST SHIPPED — v14.5.6e (MOVEMENT + LOOP FIX)
✓ gameHour crash resolved
updateEntity() referenced gameHour which was never defined. Fixed by deriving it from dayPhase (the actual time variable). Zombie fire-attraction logic now works correctly.
✓ Movement accumulator crash-proof
updateEntities() errors no longer block the accumulator from decrementing. Isolated in its own try/catch so updatePlayer always completes and accumulator always drains — prevents physics drift at 157fps+.
✓ Dev console EXIT button + reopen
Added ✕ EXIT to the dev console drawer header (always works). Boot console footer now has 🖥 DEV CON to reopen it.
✓ Boot console: Movement Probe + error throttle
🕹 MOV PROBE button snapshots uiState/joystickDelta/player pos and runs a 2s live poll. ENTITY_ERR now throttled to 1x/2s in log.

v14.5.6 — MOBILE STABILITY SURGERY
▸ WHAT I CHANGED (v14.5.6 exact fixes)
✓ ROOT CAUSE FIX: joystickDelta object reassignment bug (movement broken)
touchmove was creating a new {x,y} object each move. hardRecover mutated the old discarded object — reset had no effect. All handlers now mutate in-place: joystickDelta.x=...; joystickDelta.y=...; All 12 autorun assignment sites also fixed.
✓ ICON FIX: Sharp Stick was 🪳 (cockroach) — now 🪵
Copy-paste error in ITEMS definition. Boot scan now logs ICON_SUSPECT for any item showing roach unexpectedly.
✓ ZONE LABEL FIX: z-index raised 50→195 (above pauseOverlay:190)
✓ CRASH GUARD: RAF loop in finally{} — loop can never die from exceptions
✓ ERROR BANNER: window.onerror → shows non-blocking bottom banner
✓ MOVEMENT PROBE: probeMovementState() logs on every UI close + stuck detect
✓ HELD ITEM: equipped weapon icon drawn next to player sprite + badge above joystick
✓ UNFINISHED ITEMS: shows NO_USE_CODED_YET toast instead of silent fail
✓ LOG EXPORT: 🚨 COPY LAST ERROR button — last error + last 30 log lines
KNOWN ISSUES (still open as of v14.5.6)
• UNPROVEN: Whether joystickDelta fix alone resolves all Android movement cases — probe active
• Raiders/zombies can stick to walls in narrow corridors (AI sidestep partial fix)
• Fishing (Makeshift Rod) not yet implemented — shows NO_USE_CODED_YET
• AGENTS / SHOWRUNNER tabs are online-only placeholders — working offline replacements: COACH, TEST OPS
• Shelter + fishing rod interact conflict if both objects nearby
